text: Quantum decision models break down on complex real world decisions such as mortgages, because there is no clear way to partition the utility and the attraction functions when the underlying factors cannot be known with precision.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: It is not always clear how to partition utility and attraction functions for such complex decisions, as they depend on various factors that cannot be known with precision.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: complex real world financial decisions such as mortgages
